name: Default V (current vertical stream layout)

params.sources: Positions are fractions of the canvas. 'meld' = geometry copied from the user's Meld vertical scene that is linked to the current scene (session file of 2026-10-26). 'meld-clamped' = the Meld box runs past the canvas edge and is clamped to it (every difference is under 2 percentage points except where a layer note says otherwise). 'spec' = mirrored from Default H because the Meld vertical scene has no matching layer. Crops are in source pixels and UNVERIFIED against Meld (centred).

layers.name: Background
layers.note: Theme backdrop, mirrored from Default H. Meld draws a blurred, enlarged duplicate of the game capture here; the preset loader has no duplicate layer type, so that backdrop is a gap (see evidence). The atmos-frame canvas option is UNVERIFIED.

layers.name: Game capture
layers.note: Meld box is x -1.5 percent, width 101.6 percent (past both edges); clamped to the canvas, crop recomputed from the same uniform scale (0.866). Crop, not stretch: visible source region 1248x1080. Rounded frame in Meld (corner radius not carried). Centred crop UNVERIFIED.

layers.name: Facecam
layers.note: Shown (user 2026-11-06: camera must be visible in vertical). It was hidden in the Meld vertical scene (a duplicate of the camera, rotated 180.65 degrees there). It duplicates the H facecam layer, so it shows the camera the same way up as H. Crop (user 2026-11-06: V was stretched): the Meld crop (top/bottom 21) left a 1920x1038 area in a 521x445 box (1.85 vs 1.17); a centred side crop of 328 px on the 1920x1080 camera gives 1264x1080 (1.170), the box ratio. Crop centre UNVERIFIED.

layers.name: Subscribe call to action
layers.note: Source pending: the YouTube subscribe pill is a looping video in Meld and no legacy overlay draws it, so this is a transparent placeholder holding the geometry.

layers.name: Wordmark
layers.note: Meld has a duplicate layer here named after the brand colour wordmark; its target is not resolved (UNVERIFIED that it is the wordmark). Brand asset, local only.

layers.name: YouTube subscriber counter
layers.note: Meld duplicate named for the YouTube subscriber widget; its box is a container and ran 4.3 percentage points past the right edge (clamped). Legacy HUD draws both counters in one part and has no per-platform switch; a page option is needed (gap).

layers.name: Twitch follower counter
layers.note: Meld duplicate named for the Twitch widget; its box ran 3.5 percentage points past the left edge (clamped). Same per-platform gap as the YouTube counter. Overlaps the YouTube counter by about 6 percentage points.

layers.name: Subscribe and support call to action
layers.note: Source pending: a looping video in Meld, no legacy overlay draws it. Transparent placeholder holding the geometry. It covers the lower left of the counter area (layout issue, see evidence).

layers.name: Social ticker
layers.note: Meld duplicate of a wide social-handles strip (width 284 percent, 23 percent tall, mostly below the canvas); clamped to the bottom strip. Which part of that duplicate shows in Meld is UNVERIFIED. Legacy page reads its handles from the brand config, not from the URL; the bindings are carried for the host.

layers.name: Effects (full canvas)
layers.note: Chat Charge, full canvas, same URL option as the Meld layer.

layers.name: Voice callout
layers.note: Full canvas in Meld. Not in Default H.

layers.name: Chat Engage
layers.note: Full canvas in Meld. Not in Default H.

layers.name: Chat Storm
layers.note: Top of the Meld stack, full canvas. Shares the effect budget with Chat Charge (both are full-canvas effect pages).

layers.name: Test broadcast
layers.note: Test-stream announcement (preset test-broadcast, BM3). Moved 2026-11-06 when the V facecam was made visible (it covered the top centre-right, x 0.418-0.9, y 0.01-0.241): now the free column left of the facecam, below the subscribe call to action (ends y 0.071) and above the game box (starts y 0.239). The page shrinks its text to fit the box. Always in the scene; the page shows the banner only while the test-broadcast flag is on (polled live, D196). Rect is a proposal, UNVERIFIED on a real capture.

legacyNote: Vertical overlay URLs and options come from the legacy layer map; geometry comes from the user's Meld session (see docs/evidence/2026-11-03-a0-preset-default-v.md).
